Database.SecretDescriptionPrefix: Password for RDS MSSQL used for MAM417.
_PORT_TODO_secrets: ConnectionStrings:DefaultConnection carries the sa password verbatim from Web.config (secret flagged for manual follow-up); move it to user secrets / environment variables / AWS Secrets Manager. At runtime DatabaseConnectionResolver tries Secrets Manager first (Database.UseSecretsManager) and falls back to this value with a logged warning.
_PORT_TODO_trustServerCertificate: ConnectionStrings:DefaultConnection keeps the legacy TrustServerCertificate=true, which disables SQL Server certificate validation under Microsoft.Data.SqlClient; install a trusted certificate and remove it for non-local environments.
_PORT_TODO_appSettingsKeys: The flat 'Section.Name' keys (Database.*, Bedrock.*, Storage.*) are kept exactly as Web.config named them; Configuration/AppSettings.cs reads them (falling back to nested 'Section:Name') and binds them to DatabaseOptions / BedrockOptions / StorageOptions via AddAppSettingsOptions. Storage.RootPath '~/...' is resolved against ContentRootPath.
_PORT_TODO_entityFramework: The EF6 <entityFramework> section (SqlConnectionFactory, System.Data.Entity.SqlServer provider) is replaced by EF Core: register DocumentDbContext with AddDbContext(o => o.UseSqlServer(resolvedConnectionString)) in Program.cs, keeping DetectProvider so a PostgreSQL provider can be swapped in.
_PORT_TODO_systemWeb: <system.web> is not honored on ASP.NET Core: <compilation> and <pages controlRenderingCompatibilityVersion/clientIDMode> are dropped; <customErrors defaultRedirect='~/ErrorPage.aspx'> with 404 -> '?code=404' becomes app.UseExceptionHandler("/Error") + app.UseStatusCodePagesWithReExecute("/Error", "?code={0}") in Program.cs (mode RemoteOnly ~ use the developer exception page only in Development).
_PORT_TODO_httpRuntime: <httpRuntime maxRequestLength='512000' (KB) executionTimeout='600'> is replaced in Program.cs: Kestrel Limits.MaxRequestBodySize and FormOptions.MultipartBodyLengthLimit = 524288000 bytes (~500 MB), IBrowserFile.OpenReadStream(maxAllowedSize: Storage.MaxFileSizeMegabytes MB) per file; summarization moves to a background queue so no long request timeout is needed.
_PORT_TODO_iisWebConfig: If the app is still hosted under IIS, trim web.config to <system.webServer> before deploying (remove <system.web>, <runtime>/<assemblyBinding>, <configSections>/<entityFramework>, <connectionStrings>, <appSettings>), keep <requestLimits maxAllowedContentLength='524288000'>, and drop <defaultDocument> (Default.aspx no longer exists; routing serves '/'). The aspNetCore module handler entry is generated on publish.
_PORT_TODO_environments: Web.Debug.config -> appsettings.Development.json and Web.Release.config -> appsettings.Production.json; neither transform changes an application value (Debug is empty, Release only removes compilation debug and sets customErrors mode=On, both host settings), so no environment files are written. Set ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Production in deployments so UseExceptionHandler is active.
